reason: I have run my two-person practice on spreadsheets and WhatsApp for ten years without paying a single rupee, and adding another platform feels like unnecessary overhead. If I try it at all, I will only use the ₹0 Free Pilot rather than paying ₹12,990 upfront.
objection: Why pay nearly ₹13,000 a year when Excel and WhatsApp are completely free and my assistant and I would still have to manually forward files from 30 client chats?
would_change_my_mind: If the Free Pilot proves it saves me an hour every morning triaging those 30 WhatsApp groups without adding extra administrative work.
